prompt: Desktop web app screen for Eco-Nomz, an Indonesian surplus-food marketplace, shown edge to edge at 1440 by 900 with readable interface text and no browser frame. A restaurant owner is on the logo-and-photos step of setup and must crop a landscape 1200 by 750 PNG logo into a square restaurant mark; square uploads skip cropping. Retain the real Eco-Nomz mark, green and orange brand colors, clear owner navigation, and a compact English/Indonesian control. Lead with a horizontal four-step progress strip above the task: Details complete, Logo and photos active, Pickup details, Publish. Below it, give the editing canvas and result preview equal importance in a single clean split workspace. On the left, show the landscape Kedai Pagi logo in a wide editing area, a bright square crop boundary, dimmed overflow, and corner handles; keep rotate, reset, and zoom close to the image. On the right, show the square customer-facing preview at useful size, then the filename and exact requirement: PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB. The page title should tell the owner to make the logo fit, with one short instruction about moving and zooming. Finish with Choose another image and a prominent Save square logo action. Keep the work practical and calm, with the preview visibly tied to the crop. Do not turn the page into a dashboard or a decorative upload card.
